scope: Prevent DXF HEADER output from silently replacing a malformed explicit $CELTSCALE with the serializer's absent-value default.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Header::write emits group 40 from getDouble($CELTSCALE), but when an explicit variant has the wrong type or group, getDouble returns false and the writer emits the absent-value default 1.0. A local direct-writer reproduction using addInt($CELTSCALE, 7, 70) succeeded and serialized group 40 = 1.0.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 DXF HEADER Section Group Codes
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: $CELTSCALE is group code 40 and represents the current entity linetype scale.
CELTSCALE is a real-valued drawing variable with initial value 1.0000; the documentation does not state a zero/sign range.

implementationReadiness.compatibilityDecision: Require one exact canonical or bare CELTSCALE spelling with group-40 DOUBLE and finite value when present. Preserve every finite value, including zero and negatives, because the cited documentation establishes no numeric range. Keep malformed input readable; refuse typed output instead of substituting 1.0.
implementationReadiness.change: A non-consuming DRW_Header output check runs both at header emission and top-level DXF write preflight.

coverage: Finite positive, zero and negative CELTSCALE values retain their exact group-40 output.
Absent CELTSCALE retains the existing emitted default 1.0.
NaN and positive/negative infinity are refused without publishing a HEADER record.
Wrong variant type, wrong group, dollar/bare conflicts and case-folded duplicate aliases refuse instead of falling back to 1.0.
Parsing retains a malformed explicit input value for diagnosis; corrected same-writer retry succeeds after rollback.

focusedTests.result: PASS 2/2; CLI contract 6.83 seconds, focused header domain 0.02 seconds

cliOptionSelector.result: PASS 78 controls, including malformed CELTSCALE refusal with ASCII/Binary output destinations preserved

limitations: Only non-finite CELTSCALE values and malformed explicit group/type/key forms are refused. No sign or zero domain is claimed.
Input remains tolerant and retains malformed values for diagnosis.
